description: The bar chart titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Non-Academic" compares the performance of two models, labeled "Ours (Iterative)" and "Ours (Iterative)," across various datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis lists the datasets and metrics, which include GSM-8K, MMILU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis represents the score percentage, ranging from 0 to 80. The bars are color-coded, with "Ours (Iterative)" in blue and "Ours (Iterative)" in orange. The scores for "Ours (Iterative)" are consistently high, with the highest score being around 80% for the ARC dataset and the lowest around 60% for the LC AlpaEval-2 dataset. The "Ours (Iterative)" model shows a similar performance pattern, with scores ranging from approximately 70% to 80%. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on any of the bars.
